text.description_html:
Laurey 72866, 7/8 Inch Square Oil Rubbed Bronze Cosmopolitan Knob

The 7/8 Inch Square Oil Rubbed Bronze Cosmopolitan Knob has a transitional style that is great for most kitchens. The oil rubbed bronze finish is rich and dark. This Square Oil Rubbed Bronze Cosmopolitan Knob features a square inlay that will add interest to any lightweight door or drawer. The 7/8 Square Cabinet Knob Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Cosmopolitan Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 72866 Oil Rubbed Bronze Square Cosmopolitan Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length: 7/8" square
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available in 4 finishes:
Oil Rubbed Bronze Champagne Brass Polished Chrome Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
